name: Amazon Bedrock
description: Serves 100+ foundation models from Anthropic, OpenAI, Amazon, DeepSeek, and others through one managed AWS API for teams building generative AI apps.

skills.name: Converse API
skills.description: Calls any supported model through one consistent messages API, with tool use, guardrails, and streaming via ConverseStream.

skills.name: OpenAI-Compatible APIs
skills.description: Accepts Responses and Chat Completions requests on the bedrock-runtime endpoint for supported models.

skills.name: Cross-Region Inference
skills.description: Routes requests through global and geographic inference profiles for higher throughput and lower per-token cost.

skills.name: Web Search
skills.description: Grounds OpenAI GPT models on Bedrock in current web results through a built-in server-side tool in the Responses API.

skills.name: Guardrails
skills.description: Applies configured guardrails for content, PII, denied topics, and contextual grounding to model inputs and outputs.
